topic: Data loss after client firmware upgrade
summary_markdown:
A data issue was reported concerning CityMedia Frederiksberg, noting a lack of data after the v53 upgrade. The immediate technical recommendation was to request that the client update their firewall settings to allow MQTT connections to mqtt.allunite.com. As a temporary workaround, using Kinesis was suggested.

Later discussion focused on process improvement, specifically needing to align the upgrade procedure and confirming if all sensors had been upgraded, including those related to JCD.
decisions: The client must update their firewall to allow MQTT connections.
action_items: [p7] (Pinsker) needs to write to the client regarding the firewall updates.
Align and standardize the sensor upgrade procedure across all clients, including JCD sensors.
